name: Wendell Davis
description: Bitcointalk devotee, early Ethereum contributor, serial innovator. Deeply inspired by the potential of computing technology, deeply frustrated by its present reality, and committed to closing the gap. Recently returned from a hiatus from public and crypto life to found [Clan](https://clan.lol), [Generational Infrastructure](https://generational.systems/) and [SpacesOS](https://spacesos.org).
